newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian violence claims another 14 lives.
newsitem.headline: Colombian violence claims another 14 lives.

text.p: At least 14 people including leftist rebels and civilians died in fighting across Colombia, officials said on Wednesday.

Counterinsurgency troops killed three members of the National Liberation Army (ELN), the second largest guerrilla force, in two separate clashes in northern Cesar and northwest Antioquia provinces on Tuesday, military sources said.
Meanwhile, in eastern Casanare province three insurgents of the Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia (FARC), Colombia's oldest and largest rebel army, died in fighting.

In the trouble-torn, banana-growing Uraba region in Antioquia, four peasants were killed by suspected leftist guerrillas, police said. The area has long been the scene of bitter conflicts between rebels and right-wing paramilitary groups battling for control of lucrative contraband routes.
Three other peasants were murdered on Tuesday afternoon in unexplained circumstances near the town of Maceo, also in Antioquia province, police said.
